name: Golf – Sorry About Your Windshield
title: Golf – Sorry About Your Windshield Mug
story: This golf mug is for the golfer whose slice has met a parked car: a retro golfer in a flat cap and plus fours finishing his swing while the ball sails toward a row of vintage cars, with SORRY ABOUT above and YOUR WINDSHIELD. below. It is an easy Christmas morning coffee gift, stocking stuffer or secret Santa pick for the friend who has apologized to a clubhouse parking lot.

The print is a vintage-style illustration in navy, coral and sage: the golfer in argyle socks and patterned trousers, a dotted ball flight, and a coral car with a star on its windshield. The words are set in bold navy capitals, big enough to read from across the kitchen table, and the whole design sits on bright white glossy ceramic, on both sides of the mug.

Golfers laugh because they have done it, and everyone else gets the joke from the words alone. Pour in coffee, tea or cocoa and the mug does the talking for the person who never quite fixed that slice. It makes a good office desk mug, a thank-you for a golf buddy, or a small gift to tuck beside a bag of tees.

The mug matches our Sorry About Your Windshield crewneck sweatshirt, so the mug and the sweatshirt make a funny set for the same golfer. Every mug is printed to order by Graphic Tees Co., so the design arrives crisp and ready to give.
joke_a: The golfer's slice has found a parked car again, and the apology is printed right on the mug. The Sorry About Your Windshield mug from Graphic Tees Co. shows a vintage golfer, a ball in flight and a row of classic cars, so every golfer who has hit the clubhouse lot sees the joke with each sip of coffee.
